pages.text: Go out past the last of the land, to where the deep sea freezes into a maze.

There are pirate ships stuck in the ice. Their captain carries a horn made from a shell. Blow it near open water inside the maze and something answers. Her name was Cornelia, once. She has a key, and a page.
$(o)Sailors won't say Captain Cornelia's name, but they'll tell you she took the Black Eye down with her. Her ghost haunts the Ice Maze, over the deep frozen ocean.$()
